_comment: Acts are derived, never saved: select the highest act whose predecessor gates pass. Conditions support min_classes, quests_completed, and accomplishment counts; empty means true. reached_two_classes is monotonic across consolidation. Act V is last, so ITS advance_when is the defined-but-unreachable one -- it names seal_resolved so the finale sequence has a single gate to read, and so a maxed save still lights every beat it owns. BEAT COPY (two keys, one render rule, WIActs.render_beats): `text` is the BANKED outcome, `opening` the forward line shown while the beat is PENDING. Outcome text never renders unearned -- a pending beat with no opening is DROPPED from the journal rather than falling back to text. An opening poses its chain's question and never answers it (test_content.gd lints: authored, distinct from text, no past-tense bank markers).

beats.text: You've grown into a class of your own.
beats.opening: A class is waiting for the person you act like.

beats.text: Liscor's gates opened for you at last.
beats.opening: Liscor is a walk east, and it doesn't know you yet.

acts.title: Make a Place for Yourself
acts.header: Act II — Make a Place for Yourself

beats.text: Word of your errands is getting around town.
beats.opening: Work finds hands that take it.

beats.text: Krshia trusts you with more than gossip now.
beats.opening: Krshia's counter sees everything. Earn a look behind it.

beats.text: The Watch knows to call on you when something's wrong.
beats.opening: The Watch notices people who fix things.

beats.text: Liscor is starting to know your face.
beats.opening: Keep showing up, and the city will remember your face.

beats.text: Something is moving in the dark beneath the city.
beats.opening: Something under the city has the Watch losing sleep.

beats.text: The warren below is cleared, and the thing in the dark is cut off from its congregation.
beats.opening: Whatever moves down there has a den, and dens have doors.

acts._comment: Act V gate: the seal report plus the two region terminals the pilgrimage does not imply. Transitivity covers the rest -- lattice_forge_rune implies spine_started and elevator_pass_stamped, lattice_witch_lore requires price_of_a_favor_reported, lattice_hedault_reading requires brothers_job_done, and Act V's descent ask requires all three lattice counters. Naming them here is what keeps riverfarm_owed and invrisil_squared from being STRANDED: a beat whose counter can only bank in an act the player has already left can never render (the act_iii defect). counted_among is deliberately NOT in the gate -- it is the seal's own closing line, relocated here because post_game banks at the first sleep AFTER the seal (sleep_beat.gd). Each `opening` points at the FIRST step of its beat's chain, not the beat's outcome: the_door_opens opens on the dig east (dig -> mounted door -> catalyst -> attune -> door_awakened), the_reach_mapped on the Door's strain. SPOILER BAR (both keys): no beat line may exceed the act title. TRIPWIRE: the_reach_mapped was re-copied 2026-07-27 -- it stated Act V's reveal.
acts.title: What the Door Opened
acts.header: Act IV — What the Door Opened

beats.text: The seal holds. Liscor counts you among its own.
beats.opening: The city is deciding what you are to it.

beats.text: The pantry door remembers being elsewhere again, and somewhere else remembers it back.
beats.opening: The Horns are digging east, and they are short a pair of hands.

beats.text: Riverfarm's fields breathe easier, and a witch in the hollow no longer collects on the village's fear.
beats.opening: Riverfarm's fields hold more trouble than wheat.

beats.text: A merchant's name is settled in Invrisil, one way or another, and the Brothers remember who settled it.
beats.opening: A name needs settling in the City of Adventurers.

beats.text: The forge tier of Pallass stands open above you now, papers stamped and the lift unlocked.
beats.opening: The Walled City opens for paperwork, not heroics.

beats.text: The Horns of Hammerad have taken a corner of the inn as their own, and the seal beneath Liscor holds quiet.
beats.opening: Four adventurers need somewhere to put their feet up.

beats.text: The Door's reach has outgrown the map you started with, and you have walked all of it.
beats.opening: The Door strains for somewhere it cannot reach yet.

acts._comment: Act V, the slot #270 reserved. Every beat here banks INSIDE the act (the act_iii lesson: a beat keyed to its own act's exit gate can never render), and because act_v is last even the resolution beat renders. ONE resolution beat, not three: a per-path beat list would leave two entries permanently pending for every player. The `opening` keys carry the spoiler load for this act -- they are what a mid-Act-V player reads, and none of them may name what the vault holds; the `text` lines are outcome copy and render only once their own counter banks.
acts.title: What the Seal Was Feeding
acts.header: Act V — What the Seal Was Feeding

beats.text: Pisces will not read it out of a treatise. You are taking him down to it.
beats.opening: Pisces wants to read the seal in person, not from a treatise.

beats.text: You read the seal under Liscor yourself, in the dark, and it was never a lock at all.
beats.opening: The wardwork under Liscor is waiting to be read.

beats.text: You settled what the seal was feeding, and the city goes on not knowing.
beats.opening: What the seal keeps is still the seal's secret. Settle it.
